public_source.title: Improved bounds on the supremum of autoconvolutions
public_source.evidence: The paper states that the best nonnegative step-function example known to its authors has n=208 and reaches ||f*f||_infinity=1.50972..., and prints its associate-polynomial coefficients. The 208 published decimal coefficients are preserved locally and exactly recomputed.
public_source.scope: Located strongest public witness for the fixed 208-step configuration in the checked source set. The witness is nonnegative and therefore admissible in the signed class; its reported ||f*f||_infinity is the same maximum-absolute objective for this witness. This is a located-public-witness claim, not a proof that no other 208-step witness exists.
public_source.publication: Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications 372 (2010), no. 2, 439–447

T081-C02.comparison_tolerance: The paper prints 1.50972 to five decimal places; the exact local rational value rounds to 1.5097201507458786, within 0.000005 of the printed value. Exact Fraction checker used for the reproduced_value.

source_check_scope.reviewed: Public primary paper, the pinned official AlphaEvolve results notebook and repository record, the GGSWT2025 paper, and the signed-constant ledger entries for 300, 600, and 800 equal cells.
source_check_scope.conclusion: The other located stronger signed absolute-peak constructions use 150, 300, 600, or 800 cells. They do not match this fixed 208-step configuration. Within the checked finite source set, the 208-step Matolcsi–Vinuesa construction is the located public 208-step witness.
source_check_scope.not_claimed: Exhaustive literature search, mathematical optimality, or a universal claim that no unlocated 208-step witness exists.

limitations: The cited 208-step witness is a nonnegative construction admitted by the signed class. The paper does not claim it is optimal among all signed 208-step constructions.
The public-best statement is limited to the cited and checked finite source set. Stronger absolute-peak public reports at 150, 300, 600, and 800 cells do not match the frozen 208-step configuration.
AlphaEvolve 400-cell score 1.4557 uses the absolute value of the positive maximum, a distinct objective variant; it is excluded. The separate 800-cell one-sided result is also excluded.

details.normalization: integral-one normalization; objective is invariant under nonzero scaling
